snippet.title: PlayStation - Simple 1500 Series Vol 051 - The Jigsaw Puzzle (2000)

DESCRIPTION
The Jigsaw Puzzle is a Puzzle game, developed by AMS and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2000.
